fld_description: Effort segment identifier; primary key. Sightings reference it.
Cruise label as the effort file writes it (CCYYYY-MM, e.g. CC2004-07).
notes: cruise_label (CCYYMM) is derived from it to match the sightings

fld_description: Season of the cruise (winter, spring, summer, fall).
Segment start date-time as recorded, local Pacific clock time (M/D/YYYY H:MM).
Segment end date-time as recorded, local Pacific clock time (M/D/YYYY H:MM).
Latitude of the segment start, WGS84.
Longitude of the segment start, WGS84.
Latitude of the segment end, WGS84.
Longitude of the segment end, WGS84.
Observer comment on the segment.
Analyst comment added during curation.
CalCOFI station the segment starts from ('line-station', e.g. 90-30).
CalCOFI station the segment runs to ('line-station').
Length of the on-effort, on-transect segment.
Transect number within the survey; a transect is one or more segments between two stations.
Total on-effort length of the transect this segment belongs to.
CalCOFI line the segment runs along.
notes: dictionary field; the CalCOFI coordinate carries no SI unit

fld_description: Total on-effort length surveyed along the CalCOFI line on this cruise.
Source cruise label CCYYMM (e.g. CC0407). cruise_key is resolved from the ship track, not parsed from the label.
Season of the cruise.
Sighting date-time as recorded, local Pacific clock time (M/D/YYYY H:MM).
notes: '#REF!' in 36 CC0501 rows (Q06); converted to datetime_start_utc (Q04)

fld_description: Latitude of the sighting, WGS84.
Longitude of the sighting, WGS84.
Effort segment the sighting was made on; FK to cetacean_segment. NULL = off effort and/or off transect.
Initials of the port-side observer.
Initials of the starboard-side observer.
Observers' best estimate of the number of animals in the group.
Observers' minimum estimate of group size.
Observers' maximum estimate of group size.
Number of calves as recorded (0, 1, ..., ND = not determined, and variants; Q09).
Species code of the sighting; FK to cetacean_species.
Second species field as recorded; holds only the value 100, on 59 CC2111 rows (Q05).
Observer's original on/off effort flag, as recorded (mixed case).
Reason code when off effort.
Observer's original on/off transect flag, as recorded.
Reason code when off transect.
Analyst-adjusted flag: ON when the sighting was both on effort and on transect, else OFF.
Primary behaviour code(s) of the group (numeric codes; codebook is Q03).
Secondary behaviour code(s).
Tertiary behaviour code(s).
Observer comments.
Ship speed over ground at the sighting.
Analyst comment added during curation.
Species code; primary key.
Common name.
Mysticete, Odontocete or Unidentified.
